title: Mookuthi Amman 2 Scores 3.6/10 With Critics
headline: Mookuthi Amman 2 Scores 3.6/10 With Critics
caption:
Mookuthi Amman 2 finishes last of the six Diwali releases idly ranked. Half the reviews idly read say Nayanthara still holds the screen, but 9 of 10 fault the screenplay and 6 call the effects cheap. NDTV's Latha Srinivasan says it "desperately needed a storytelling miracle".

idly's consolidated score: 3.6/10, the mean of 11 numeric ratings from idly's fixed panel of 47 Indian English-language outlets (newspapers, TV and news sites, established film publications), published on or after release and confirmed on the outlet's page or in two independent listings, converted to /10.

How much do the effects matter to you in a devotional fantasy, next to the story and the star?

Sources: ratings from OnlyKollywood, DT Next, 123Telugu, Filmfare, NDTV, Times of India, India Today, Indian Express, Cinema Express, Gulte and Rediff; read on the outlets' pages or in thereviewmonk, Rotten Tomatoes, Sacnilk and BollyMovieReviewz. Highs and lows from the 10 reviews idly read in full.

#MookuthiAmman2 #Nayanthara #TamilCinema #MovieReview
